parts: Create a CUTOUT ANIMATION RIG KIT of the exact referenced fantasy game character. NOT an animation sheet, NO full figures. Twelve complete separate parts, EXACT FOUR COLUMNS THREE ROWS, one item per cell on TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Fine ink outlines and painted cel shading matching reference, upper-left light, strict side / slight three-quarter game view facing RIGHT. Compact parts with generous transparent gaps; all pieces entirely inside their cells, no clipping. Rounded overlap at joints, no exposed diagram circles, no shadows, no labels or text. Limb segments must point STRAIGHT DOWN with the proximal joint at TOP, distal joint at BOTTOM, no diagonal posing. Head fully naturally outlined with transparent margin, not cropped, no torso. Torso armless, no head or hips; pelvis no torso or legs. Upper arm no forearm, forearm no hand. Thigh no shin, shin no foot. Boots toe RIGHT, ankle LEFT rear. Weapons must not be attached to any body part except their gripping hand. Read row-major left-to-right: ROW1: 1 HEAD of LUPINOR, handsome adult male elf with pointed ear, silver hair swept close to skull, head plus short neck only, NO long loose hair (separate piece), no scarf or shoulders; 2 lean dark NAVY silver-trimmed armored TORSO, teal shoulder scarf, neck to waist only NO arms; 3 dark armored PELVIS/belt/tassets only; 4 long SILVER HAIR tuft alone flowing horizontally LEFT from root at RIGHT, no head or face. ROW2: 1 dark navy/silver armored UPPER ARM vertical shoulder to elbow; 2 dark navy/silver FOREARM bracer vertical elbow to wrist, NO hand or crossbow; 3 RIGHT GLOVED HAND gripping a SCIMITAR, long curved silver blade pointing horizontally RIGHT, no arm; 4 short TEAL CAPE alone flowing horizontally LEFT from clasp at RIGHT. ROW3: 1 lean dark navy armored THIGH vertical; 2 dark navy silver-trimmed SHIN knee to ankle vertical, NO foot; 3 flat-soled BOOT FOOT toe RIGHT no shin; 4 LEFT GLOVED HAND with compact WRIST-MOUNTED CROSSBOW pointing RIGHT, NO long forearm or arrow trail. Preserve reference silver-haired elf face, navy armor, teal cape, silver scimitar and wrist crossbow. Exactly twelve isolated parts, NO whole character, NO purple clothing, NO feminine face.
